carrierFunding.secondOutput: 0-amount dummy to a fresh random address (wallet2-like); no self-payment dust
carrierFunding.offlineChainFee: 2,520-byte transfer carrier = 3,024,000,000 piconero (0.003024 XMR) at the fakechain rate of 1,200,000 piconero/byte; redemption carrier 2,449 bytes
carrierFunding.mainnetFee: NOT estimated here; the popup shows an illustrative figure at 20,000 piconero/byte (about 0.0000504 XMR for 2,520 bytes), labelled; real rates come from the node at send time
carrierFunding.retry: same signed carrier re-sent on lost replies/restarts (idempotent on monerod); never an automatic second carrier
carrierFunding.relayStillNeededFor: nothing for correctness; only fee sponsorship for holders without XMR or IP decoupling, both product decisions with their own metadata exposure
